speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The Smart Nation and Digital Government Group (SNDGG) aims to build a Smart Nation where people acquire relevant skills for new jobs in a digital future and our enterprises become more competitive and productive by leveraging on technology.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will drive digital transformation nationwide, build long-term capabilities within Government, and enhance services to the public.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The COVID-19 crisis has brought to the fore the importance of digitalisation, and the importance of developing deep engineering capabilities to respond effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: GovTech rapidly engineered digital solutions to enable a more effective response to COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: TraceTogether and SafeEntry have helped to make contact tracing faster and more accurate.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We have started distribution of TraceTogether tokens to seniors and those who do not own smartphones.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The Government also built a suite of digital tools to direct Singaporeans to the relevant delivery points of essential items like masks and tokens.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We have adapted to Circuit Breaker and the urgent need to reduce physical contact by accelerating digitalisation: home-based learning and working were widely practised, and more businesses and Government services have shifted online.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our quick response and adaption have been possible because we have been steadily building our digital foundations and capabilities over the past few years.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: COVID-19 presents both a challenge, but also an opportunity to leverage and build on our gains in digitalisation.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We must grasp this opportunity and accelerate the transformation of Government, Economy, and Society through technology, to allow us to emerge stronger into a post-COVID-19 world.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Many agencies have already brought forward their timelines in view of COVID-19.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: This enables all citizens and businesses to transact with us in a paperless, "presence-less", and cashless manner, for greater convenience, and at this time, with greater safety.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to put users at the centre, and maintain high citizen and business satisfaction with digital Government services, which were at 86% and 78% in 2019 respectively.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We rebranded the Moments of Life app as LifeSG.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The app now provides a one-stop directory of key Government services grouped by topics and provides recommendations on programmes and events, based on the user’s profile and interests.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will add more features and personalisation in the coming months.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will use technology to build Singapore into a Smart City, and to improve quality of life.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: JTC's Open Digital Platform at Punggol Digital District enables centralised and more efficient district management.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The Housing Development Board's (HDB) Smart Hub integrates data to improve estate management and facilitate better town planning.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: These will be linked to the Smart Nation Sensor Platform to enable even more use cases.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We continue to strengthen our cyber and data security measures and update our data governance policies.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We are implementing the recommendations made by the Public Sector Data Security Review Committee, which will strengthen the Government's data security regime.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will continue to improve on these measures to ensure that data is safeguarded and used securely.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: For greater transparency, we will also publish and report on past data incidents.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Amidst a global downturn, we must ensure economic resilience and preserve jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: For Singapore to remain competitive and innovative in the post-COVID-19 world, businesses need to accelerate their digital transformation.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: SNDGG will support the work by the Ministry of Communications and Information (MCI), Ministry of Trade and Industry (MTI), and the various sector leads to build a digital economy and create more jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: In particular, we will use artificial intelligence (AI) to drive the next phase of Smart Nation, and implement the National AI Strategy.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will make it simpler, better and faster for businesses to transact digitally with the Government.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: With COVID-19, the GoBusiness platform was enhanced to help businesses to stay up-to-date on COVID-19-related regulations and apply for exemptions.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: GoBusiness also launched an e-Adviser to help businesses better identify relevant government support based on companies’ needs.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Going forward, the platform will be expanded to include more services and personalised recommendations.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: To facilitate businesses going digital, the Government is working closely with the industry to build up national digital infrastructure, platforms and standards, that can be used by both the public and private sectors.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: The National Digital Identity platform will provide a suite of trusted services to help business digitise and transact securely with customers.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our E-Payments infrastructure enables seamless and secure payment.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our digitalisation efforts will help develop capabilities within the local Information and Communications Technology (ICT) sector.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Even as we push ahead with our digital transformation as a nation, every Singaporean must feel that they are a part of and can benefit from Smart Nation.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: To do so, digital technology must enhance, instead of replace, the human touch.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Our digital services, for both public and private sector, need to be accessible and inclusive.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We will also continue to support the SG Together movement by engaging Singaporeans to experience, understand and co-create digital technology.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: We launched "SmartNation Together", an online series featuring tech-related talks and workshops, for all age groups.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Many of these are conducted by Smart Nation Ambassadors, who are volunteers from all walks of life, united by a passion for tech.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Singaporeans will also be able to co-create Smart Nation initiatives.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: At Smart Nation Co-Creating with Our People Everywhere (SCOPE) sessions, citizens can try out prototypes of upcoming products and share ideas on how to improve our services.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: COVID-19 presents both a need and opportunity to make profound digital transformations and in doing so, emerge stronger as a nation.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Within the Government, SNDGG will accelerate the building up of engineering talent and foundations that enable more agile use of IT and data, such as the Government Data Architecture.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: These have proven to be invaluable in this time of crisis.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: All ministries are pursuing plans to raise their digital maturity.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: Across our economy, tripartite partners are working together to raise digital skills, develop digital infrastructure, and enable companies to innovate.

speaker: The Minister for Foreign Affairs (Dr Vivian Balakrishnan)
text: This will ensure that digitalisation benefits Singapore and Singaporeans, by transforming how we deliver Government services, grow new economic opportunities, strengthen the core of local talent, and improve the lives of our people.
